fabricated_details: Time Noticed: Before 1:40 PM (Work order submitted at 1:40 PM)
Monitor status of Work Order #4471 for M-16 (Forklift #2).
Verify repair completion and perform safety check before returning M-16 to service.

rationale: The report captures all input facts and is very readable, but it severely overinflates the severity of a flat tire to HIGH and hallucinates numerous operational procedures, status labels, and monitoring steps not present in the supervisor input. It also guesses the shift letter despite the input explicitly leaving it unspecified. Consequently, its accuracy, severity, and uncertainty handling are poor.
